title: A Tanaka-Type Formula for Compact Sets and Equilibrium Measures of Lévy Processes
summary: Tanaka's formula is a classical identity for Brownian motion, and Tsukada (2018) extended it to Lévy processes not necessarily symmetric. From a potential-theoretic point of view, this formula shows that the invariant function for the process killed upon hitting a singleton can be decomposed into the sum of a martingale part and a local time. In this paper, we generalize this singleton setting and derive a Tanaka-type formula for a compact set $B$.
